integrity: Proof given by finite-dimensional spectral decomposition and exact scalar optimization. Computational checks are supplementary, not a replacement for proof; originality comparison does not assert exhaustive historical coverage.
scientific_limitations: Only the positive-semidefinite cone in three-by-three complex or real matrices is covered.
No unrestricted Schur multiplier norm or higher-dimensional sharp constant is inferred.
No full-text comparison was possible for the 1992 Angelos–Cowen–Narayan article or the 1970 Kwapień–Pełczyński article.
title: Sharp positivity-restricted triangular truncation in dimension three
